systemStatus.detail:
SAT AUG 22 7:05 AM PT RUN.

TOAST -- Friday Aug 21 is IN, from the group nightly email that arrived 6:30 AM PT. Net sales $7,160.85 on gross $7,447.45, 199 orders, 295 guests, $35.98 average per order, $24.27 per guest. That is +$1,949.50 net over Thursday Aug 20 and the strongest single day currently on the board. Labor came in at 22.8% of net (~$1,632.67 derived), up from Thursday's 20.6% but still healthy. Discounts $286.60 (3.8% of gross), zero refunds, zero gift-card deferrals, 17 void items, 170 card payments, 0 remaining open orders. Julianna Ornelas was auto-clocked out. The 229 W Montecito single-location Daily Performance Summary for Friday had NOT arrived by 7:05 AM -- it lands ~7:40 AM PT -- so checks, average check, void dollars, dayparts, revenue centers, sales categories, same-day-last-week and the 4-week average are still blank for Friday and will backfill tomorrow. Thursday Aug 20 rolls to the previous-day slot with its full detail intact.

SLING -- Saturday's roster arrived 7:00 AM PT, so today's schedule is live rather than carried forward. 13 scheduled employees across 13 shifts, 82.25 scheduled hours, 0 uncovered shifts, 2 employees off. NEW AND WORTH A LOOK: 5.25 overtime hours are on the schedule today. Friday had zero. Headcount is up 3 and hours up 27.0 versus Friday, which tracks for a Saturday, but the OT is the first this window and is worth confirming is intentional. Kitchen shows a single Cook (Isael Salvador Narciso) against 13 total bodies -- front of house is well covered, back of house is thin on paper.

REVIEWS -- carried forward from this morning's 4:05 AM run, which verified both Google listings live in Chrome. Not re-scraped at 7:05. THE BREWHOUSE (4.5, 526 reviews) has FOUR unanswered: sergio salazar (5*), Betty Chambers (5*), John Rinaldo (1*, no text), and Donald Clay (1*, alleges botulism from a taco). The Donald Clay review is live, public, and still unanswered. Treat as urgent: pull the Aug 8 lunch ticket and taco prep/temperature logs, notify the insurance carrier, and get counsel's eyes on it before any public reply. A draft reply exists but has NOT been posted. BREWHOUSE COFFEE (5.0, 5 reviews) has one unanswered: Geoff Lay (5*, Horchata Latte). Separately, the Yelp listing (3.8, 773 reviews) shows 15 unread inbox items and a Reviews badge of 1 that nobody has triaged.

GOOGLE ADS -- dashboard read live at both Yesterday and Last-7-days ranges. Aug 21: 230 impressions, 11 clicks, 4.78% CTR, $10.02 cost, $0.91 avg CPC, 0 conversions. Impressions rose 60 day-over-day but CTR halved from 8.82% and spend fell $12.96. The main restaurant Performance Max campaign ('Local store visits and promotions', $58.37/day budget) is CONFIRMED STILL PAUSED -- day five with the restaurant getting zero paid Google traffic. All spend is the $15/day coffee search campaign. Two account notices: Google is prompting for a BACKUP PAYMENT METHOD, and the Aug 17 campaign-targets policy banner is showing. No disapprovals. Last 7 days (Aug 15-21): 4,615 impressions, 152 clicks, $321.64, 48 conversions, $2.12 avg CPC.

YELP ADS -- live scrape succeeded again, second clean run since the login wall cleared. Last 30 days: 40.3k ad impressions (79% of 51.3k total), 363 ad clicks, 440 page visits from ads (58% of 763), 100 leads from ads (67% of 149). Trailing 12 months: 1,250 ad leads vs 716 organic. Billing period Aug 1-21: $275.90 spend, $1.07 CPC, $3.94 cost-per-lead -- Yelp is delivering leads at roughly a quarter of what a Google click costs right now. Ad confirmed live at $13/day average, 5-mile radius, audience size 'Ideal'. Yelp still flags 1 remaining ad setup item. Bonus budget was not displayed again this run.

TRIPADVISOR -- nothing new in 24h. Nothing actionable.

TODAY'S SHORT LIST: (1) the botulism review, still unanswered on day 14; (2) restart or deliberately kill the paused PMax restaurant campaign, day 5; (3) add the Google Ads backup payment method; (4) confirm the 5.25 OT hours on today's schedule are intentional; (5) triage the 15 unread Yelp inbox items.

I'd like to look into your visit directly -- please reach me at the restaurant at (805) 884-4664 or mojobrewhouse@gmail.com so I can get the details. unanswered.handlingNote: DO NOT POST WITHOUT REVIEW. Public allegation of foodborne illness. Recommend: (1) pull the Aug 8 lunch ticket and taco prep/temp logs before responding, (2) notify your insurance carrier, (3) consider a quick call with counsel. Never admit or deny causation in a public reply -- acknowledge, express concern, move it offline.
